environment: WSL, Bun 1.4.3, production createDesktopService + real HTTP, app dev.5 / NetEase alpha.10 / schema9
scope: one real NetEase liked playlist cold scan; no fixed playlist input, no warm full scan, no Cloudflare or Windows host

consumer.scope: one real cold full scan, one directory allprop, two local HEAD and one 1KiB audio tail; no warm full scan

oneUnavailableSample.scope: one previously hidden real item, one native playback request, no audio download

limits: One real journey, not a controlled old/new comparison or platform stress test.
Header waits overlap and omit response-body time; do not subtract their sum from wall time to estimate local CPU.
Zero HTTP429 does not exclude platform business-level throttling; temporary business failures were observed and bounded retries continued.
A stale offline QQ test occupied one CPU core during the first portion; it was identified and stopped without restarting this refresh.
1KiB tail validates Range and content identity, not full audio decode or Windows mounting.
